facts.fact: GICTA unveiled on 25 November 2026 a prototype Integrated Digital Cabinet Management System developed in-house by its staff and staff from other government bodies, which the Director General says cost under US$150,000 against US$1-5 million through international procurement; the course was delivered by Business Automation Limited and funded by the World Bank under WARDIP.

systems.owner: Gambia Information and Communications Technology Agency (GICTA)

GMB.note: WARDIP is a World Bank programme named only as funder of training; no African body or agreement stated.
